1.w: “Does not humanity have hard service on earth? Are not their days also like the days of a hired man?

2.w: Like a servant longing for the evening shadow, and like a hired man looking for his wages,

3.w: thus I have been made to inherit months of futility, and nights of sorrow have been appointed to me.

4.w: If I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise?’ And the night stretches on, and I toss and turn restlessly until the day dawns.

5.w: My body is clothed with worms and dirty scabs; my skin is broken and festering.

6.w: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and they come to an end without hope.

7.w: Remember that my life is but a breath, that my eyes will never again see happiness.

8.w: The eye of him who sees me now will see me no more; your eyes will look for me, but I will be gone.

9.w: As a cloud is dispersed and then disappears, so the one who goes down to the grave does not come up again.

10.w: He returns no more to his house, nor does his place of residence know him anymore.

11.w: “Therefore, I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

12.w: Am I the sea, or the creature of the deep, that you must put me under guard?

13.w: If I say, ‘My bed will comfort me, my couch will ease my complaint,’

14.w: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me with visions,

15.w: so that I would prefer strangling and death more than life.

16.w: I loathe it; I do not want to live forever; leave me alone, for my days are a vapor!

17.w: “What is mankind that you make so much of them, and that you pay attention to them?

18.w: And that you visit them every morning, and try them every moment?

19.w: Will you never look away from me, will you not let me alone long enough to swallow my spittle?

20.w: If I have sinned—what have I done to you, O watcher of men? Why have you set me as your target? Have I become a burden to you?

21.w: And why do you not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For now I will lie down in the dust, and you will seek me diligently, but I will be gone.”
